sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(DateKey) as max_date FROM retail.FactInventory) SELECT p.ProductName, i.OnHandQuantity, i.SafetyStockQuantity FROM retail.FactInventory i JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey JOIN latest ON i.DateKey = latest.max_date WHERE i.OnHandQuantity < i.SafetyStockQuantity
